$comment: Production dependencies whose license is outside the allowlist in src/license-check.ts, recorded while counsel reviews them (gate 11). Each entry covers one package name (a trailing * matches platform builds) under one exact license; licenses:check reports them as warnings and fails on anything else. Counsel's ruling changes the status to Approved by counsel, or the dependency is removed.

exceptions.reason: The Sentry command line tool, pulled in by @sentry/nextjs through @sentry/bundler-plugins, uploads source maps at build time; it is not served to users. Waiting on counsel to confirm that the Functional Source License (Apache-2.0 two years after each release) permits this use.
exceptions.decision: Owner decisions in legal/qa/gate-status.md: counsel review of FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0. The owner approved the use on 2026-10-24; counsel confirms.

exceptions.reason: Prebuilt libvips for sharp, which Next.js uses to optimize images on the server. It is loaded as an unmodified shared library; waiting on counsel to confirm the notice and relinking obligations. One package per platform (darwin-arm64 locally, linux-x64 in CI and on Vercel).
exceptions.decision: Owner decisions in legal/qa/gate-status.md: counsel review of LGPL-3.0-or-later. The owner approved the use on 2026-10-24; counsel confirms.
